provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: ISS Vanguard rulebook (Awaken Realms, via RulesPal)

steps.text: First time: play the Tutorial (Chapter II, ideally solo); afterwards start the Campaign with this quickstart
Sections (Engineering, Recon, Science, Security) per player: {s}
Card Trays and Ship Book organized as in "Before your First Play" (tutorial cards back in their trays)

On the table: Reference cards, Danger Die card, 4 Crew boards, Card Trays A and B, Section Compartments, Planetopedia, Start token and tokens, 12 Injury dice, 2 Danger dice, 5 Tutorial Events, Tutorial Rank-Up card
Read the Starting Log (first Log in the Logbook)
Each player takes the Crew boards of their Sections
Per Section: draw 3 from Recruits, keep 2 in Rank 1 sleeves: 1 on the Crew board, 1 to Resting Crew; shuffle the rest back
Section dice into the Crew board slots; unused dice back in the box
Away Team: each player sends 1 of their Sections (solo: 2); the others go to Resting Crew and their dice to their Compartment
Each Away Team Crewmember shuffles the 10 white-bar Rank 1 Section cards as their Section deck, left of the Crew board
Planetopedia at pages 02-03 (Eye of the Void); Tutorial Rank-Up card Incomplete side up
Mission M01 faceup, Unique Discovery 1 facedown; shuffle the 5 Tutorial Event cards beside the board
One ringed mini per Away Team Section in Sectors 1 and 2 (at least one in each)
A Turn token on Turn Available by each Crew board; Charges slot empty
Read the Mission card aloud; each Section draws 2 Section cards
An Away Team needs at least 2 Crewmembers from different Sections
Each turn: 2 Actions (Special Action once), then flip your Turn token and draw an Event
Logs are not in order: read only the number you are sent to
The Recon player gives the Start token to a Crewmember; go to Log 1
